annotation.bound_parties_text: The advisory circular addresses operators of small remotely piloted aircraft systems (drone operators) under 25 kilograms flying under Part 101, and encourages training providers and aviation groups to use it; it describes an acceptable means of compliance rather than imposing binding obligations.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: This Advisory Circular (AC) describes an acceptable means of compliance when operating small remotely piloted aircraft systems (RPAS) that weigh less than 25 kilograms
annotation.dates_quote: CAA is encouraging drone operators, training providers, and aviation groups to start using the Trial AC from 22nd December
annotation.robot_provision_quote: Revision 2 is a substantive update which updates content throughout and removes obsolete content.
